name: recursive-character-splitter
explain: Implement recursive character chunking from first principles. Evaluates hierarchical delimiters (paragraphs, sentences, words) in order to keep complete conceptual and heading units together within a token budget.
steps: Attempt splitting on high-level paragraph boundaries before falling back to sentence or word breaks. || Merge adjacent text segments up to the chunk size while keeping section headers attached to their introductory text.

name: semantic-chunking-distance
explain: Implement Semantic Chunking using embedding cosine distance variance across consecutive sentences. Dynamically places chunk boundaries at statistical topic transition spikes rather than arbitrary token counts.
steps: Compute cosine distances between adjacent sentence embeddings across the document. || Detect statistical distance spikes exceeding the percentile threshold and create dynamic chunk boundaries.
expect: Semantic chunking verified: chunk_count=2, transition_distance=0.9855, threshold=0.9855

name: token-sliding-window
explain: Implement token-aware sliding window chunking with strict stride invariants. Validates that overlap is strictly smaller than chunk_size to guarantee forward progress, and preserves token start/end coordinates for citations.
steps: Validate that chunk size is positive and overlap is strictly less than size. || Advance by size minus overlap (stride) and track exact token spans for citation highlight mapping.
expect: Sliding window verified: total_chunks=4, stride=3, invalid_overlap_rejected=True

name: content-fingerprint-cache
explain: Implement cryptographic content fingerprinting and chunk cache invalidation. Incorporates source text, position, and chunker configuration (size, overlap, tokenizer) into the hash, ensuring parameter changes invalidate stale embeddings.
steps: Compute SHA-256 fingerprint from document content and pipeline transformation settings. || Verify that tuning chunker parameters deterministically invalidates the chunk cache even when source text is unchanged.
expect: Content fingerprint verified: fp_v1=e704e6c381c8163f..., fp_v2=75ba2cb9c5f5ca8c..., invalidated=True

name: late-chunking-global-context
explain: Demonstrate Late Chunking vs Early Chunking in long-context embedding models. Early chunking embeds isolated fragments losing cross-sentence context; Late chunking passes full document context through self-attention before pooling chunk spans.
steps: Demonstrate semantic dilution and missing referents when ambiguous chunks are embedded in isolation. || Apply Late Chunking by pooling token hidden states that have attended across full document context, boosting retrieval similarity.
expect: Late chunking verified: early_sim=0.9419, late_sim=0.9991, context_gain=0.0573

name: deterministic-chunk-id
explain: Generate deterministic, idempotent chunk UUIDs using document namespaces and content hashes. Enables idempotent database upserts and prevents orphan duplicate vectors across pipeline reruns.
steps: Construct deterministic UUIDv5 scoped to a stable document namespace and chunk position. || Re-run chunking on identical documents and assert 100% chunk ID stability across pipeline executions.

name: hierarchical-parent-child-retrieval
explain: Implement Hierarchical Parent-Child chunking. Indexes small child passages for high vector similarity matching while returning the expanded parent context to LLM generation prompts to prevent context truncation.
steps: Index fine-grained child passages mapped to a parent section identifier. || Match the child passage via vector search and expand to full parent context for generation.
expect: Parent-child retrieval verified: matched_child=sla_section_4_c1, parent_length=351 chars

name: chunk-overlap-evaluation
explain: Evaluate retrieval recall under chunk overlap without miscounting duplicate hits as extra evidence. Deduplicates overlapping results from the same source passage before measuring criteria coverage.
steps: Demonstrate how overlapping chunk windows create false high hit counts while crowding out distinct policy exceptions. || Deduplicate by source section identity to evaluate true criteria coverage rate.
expect: Chunk overlap evaluation verified: naive_hits=4/5, true_criteria_coverage=50.0%, missing={'exception_clause'}
